fields.description: Mirage brings five- and six-bedroom villas to The Oasis, with homes arranged beside waterways and landscaped public spaces. The collection includes different elevations and flat or drop configurations. Large windows, planted surroundings and separate service areas shape the residential design.

overview: The brochure gives Mirage a water-led landscape, with gardens, play spaces and places for exercise spread through the neighbourhood. Five-bedroom villas are presented in Classic, Contemporary and Chamfered styles; the six-bedroom examples use Contemporary and Chamfered elevations. The visual language varies, while the emphasis on generous family accommodation remains consistent.
research.locationNote: Mirage is within The Oasis, Dubai, near D54 and E44. Emaar places it within reach of Dubai Hills, Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai. Journey times in launch material are estimates, so check the route from the particular plot.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 15.8m. The launch fact sheet quotes five-bedroom villas from AED 15.8m and six-bedroom villas from AED 20.5m. These are historic entry references, not confirmation of current available homes.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule allocates 90% before completion and 10% at completion. The two Emaar-branded documents are hosted by a broker; their dated instalments are historical launch terms, not a fresh offer.
research.handoverNote: The launch payment document estimates June 2028. Property Finder reports May 2028. Both fall in Q2, but the month remains inconsistent; confirm the current contractual date.

facts.label: Launch mix
facts.value: 204 villas: 123 five-bedroom and 81 six-bedroom homes. This is the development mix, not available stock.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Plan totals include basement, floors, terraces and carport; they are not plot measurements. Flat and drop describe villa configurations.

facts.label: Layouts
facts.value: The six-bedroom drop sheets show basement, ground and first floors; the other reviewed variants also show a roof floor. A lift and driver’s accommodation appear in the plans.

facts.label: Outdoor works
facts.value: The official plans mark landscaping as illustrative and owner-designed. Confirm pool, garden and other external works in the sale specification.
